It reads from the Catalogue Database in the internal zone, which holds course descriptions and schedules but no personal data. An Admin Console in the internal zone lets staff edit course records. Edits are written to the Catalogue Database directly. A nightly Sync Job in the internal zone pushes the catalogue to the external Partner Feed, a third-party aggregator reached over the public internet.
